# Coresift

> Coresift, by Inspirium Tech Pvt Ltd (Ahmedabad, India), is the world's first clinical-grade infant intelligence system. Proprietary, non-contact sensor fusion tracks a baby's breathing, temperature and vitals through swaddles and blankets, translates cries into their physiological cause, and connects families to a 24/7 on-call pediatrician armed with the infant's biometric trends.

Key facts:

- Product: Coresift, a clinical-grade, non-contact infant intelligence system (camera + infrared thermal imaging + acoustic AI, fused).
- Nothing touches the baby: vitals and micro-respiratory rhythms are read through swaddles and blankets. No socks, straps or wires.
- The Unseen Breath: tracks micro-respiratory rhythms and vitals without contact.
- The Unheard Cry: AI-driven acoustic translation identifies the physiological cause of distress: hunger, fatigue or pain.
- The Invisible Threat: continuous ambient and surface mapping catches anomalies before they escalate.
- The Core Promise: by predicting wake-ups before they happen, parents gain nearly 45 minutes of extra uninterrupted deep sleep a week, about 36 extra hours a year.
- The 3:00 AM Clinical Bridge: 24/7 connection to an on-call pediatrician who instantly sees the infant's continuous biometric trends and acoustic logs, replacing guesswork with data-driven triage.
- Status: advanced clinical pilots underway; first production run being finalized. Early access via waitlist.
- Founders: Jeet Patel (Founder & Product Lead) and Nayan Mevada (Co-Founder & Tech Lead).
- Contact: contact@inspiriumtech.com
